# PaceStreak

> PaceStreak is a habit and streak tracker for training and everything else worth doing regularly: learning, health, calm, and habits being broken. Each habit keeps a weekly streak, so rest days never break it. It also logs workouts and food, keeps a private mood journal, and finds patterns in your own data without AI. No ads, no analytics, no third-party scripts.

The product is a web app at https://app.pacestreak.com (sign-up required). This site describes it; it has no forms and no API for agents.

## Product

- [Features](https://www.pacestreak.com/features): every feature, including habits, routines, training, food, insights, streaks, social and data export
- [How streaks work](https://www.pacestreak.com/streaks): week-based streaks, freezes, repairs and pauses, with a simulator
- [Social and privacy rules](https://www.pacestreak.com/social): what others can and cannot see; habits are never shown to anyone
- [Security](https://www.pacestreak.com/security): passkeys, two-factor sign-in and how data is protected
- [FAQ](https://www.pacestreak.com/faq): common questions
- [Changelog](https://www.pacestreak.com/changelog): what changed, newest first

## Company

- [About](https://www.pacestreak.com/about): why it exists and the principles it is built on
- [Privacy](https://www.pacestreak.com/privacy): what is collected, why, who processes it, and how to export or delete it
- [Terms](https://www.pacestreak.com/terms): terms of use
